items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: And I said, 'Hey, Judge.' And he sent me a birthday card... That was a real pleasant surprise, you know?

ctx.x: Oh, I don't know. Let's see, how did -- it's almost like a standard nickname for each other. You know, Milt has a very high voice. "Hey, Judge?" That's the way he sounds, you know. And I said, "Hey, Judge." And he sent me a birthday card, as I was telling you. He says, "I hereby sentence you to 30 days of good music." And I've got to call him back, because I didn't know that he knew when my birthday was. That was a real pleasant surprise, you know?
